blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian on Wednesday called for a review of firearm issuance, storage, and access protocols following the foiling of a plot by three minors to carry out a mass shooting at their school in Batac, Ilocos Norte. Gatchalian stressed the need to keep firearms securely stored and beyond the reach of minors, emphasizing that gun owners must exercise utmost responsibility to prevent unauthorized access to their weapons. “Let us not wait for another incident of violence, whether inside or outside schools, before taking action,” Gatchalian said.
